dialogues.speaker: Patrol Soldier
dialogues.text: Stop! I have orders to search for a wanted criminal!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yikes! Hide — quick!

dialogues.speaker: Patrol Soldier
dialogues.text: You! The warrant is for your arrest! Freeze!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no — run!

dialogues.speaker: Patrol Soldier
dialogues.text: Stop! I have orders to search for a wanted criminal!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yikes! Hide — quick!

dialogues.speaker: Patrol Soldier
dialogues.text: You! The warrant is for your arrest! Freeze!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no — run!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Hey Dad, want to play a game of Genius Invokation?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: But before we play, I got one thing to say to you! If you're already tipsy from drinking today, then the game will be over in three rounds.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: In three rounds? Sounds like you're underestimating your dear father.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: I'm pretty sure I could drag the game out to at least five rounds.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Hmph! And you'd still lose! You think that's something to be proud of?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Last time we played, you mistook the Hydro Elemental Dice you rolled for Cryo! Ugh, so annoying!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Haha, you know I have a problem with my eyesight...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: No, you have a problem with drinking! Don't try to cover it up!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, I know, drinking is bad. I won't drink today, not even a single drop. There, happy?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: I guess so.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Now, if I DO win, what's the prize?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: What? You're trying to get me to mix you a drink? Don't you even think about it!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: What if I win in under five rounds?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: In your dreams, I won't lose! Let's start!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: So, you leave for a few days and come back with some serious TCG skills. Care to explain?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I was fortunate enough to have played a match with a skilled opponent.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Oh? And who might that be? Wait, let me try to guess...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Ningguang doesn't have the time for this sort of thing... Hmm, Xiangling and Xinyan aren't usually practicing either...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: If Yaoyao were free, she'd be running down to the ship to say hi to everyone, so that rules her out.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: #Hah, could it be {NICKNAME}? Did {M#he}{F#she} happen to be in Liyue Harbor?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: #Sorry Captain, you still haven't guessed it. But I did happen to see {NICKNAME}, and even forged a new friendship over cards...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Oh, made a new friend, huh? Then I won't be able to guess it.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes, I met Hu Tao, director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Have you heard of her?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Yeah, I've heard of her before. Isn't she the one that won the King of Invokations Grand Prix in Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: That's right. She said that she's been an admirer of yours for a long time, and hopes to make your acquaintance one day.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Alright! There isn't a better opportunity!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: We'll invite her aboard to play a few matches, and I'll get a taste of playing against a champion.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Oh, speaking of which, perhaps I should go find her personally at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. You know, to show some sincerity.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, did you make the trip all the way back here just to see me?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Ah, so that's what you uncovered in the end. Hmm, I'm not quite sure how I feel about that.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: But thank you for letting me know.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Hearing how things ended almost feels like reading the end of a light novel. Now we can all rest at ease.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: "Winning or losing isn't what's most important. It's about playing with elegance." That's how I've always looked at it, anyway.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: After seeing you all cheering for me though, I suppose I really tried to bring my best to the game.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Hehe... Now that I think about it, it was great that I was able to speak with you before the competition.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Energy +5?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Ah! No, please don't ever mention that to anyone!

choices.text: I'll be on my way, then.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Since you came all the way to Watatsumi Island, you might as well rest for a moment before you return.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I hope this view will stay in your heart forever.

choices.text: I'll be on my way, then.
I'll be on my way, then.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, what a coincidence! Cyno already told me everything that happened.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: I'll stop you right there! Cyno has already told me countless jokes with that smug look on his face. I don't want to hear any more.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: That's all I have to say on that topic.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Things have been quiet in the Avidya Forest lately, so I've been playing with Collei every now and then.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Collei never ceases to amaze me. She even managed to place well in that tournament.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Even though I was able to make it out of the qualifiers, luck wasn't on my side and I faced Cyno only a few matches in.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: That guy shows no mercy when it comes to Genius Invokation. He even let out a loud yell when he played the winning card... It really hurt my ears.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: It's been a while since I've seen him get so stirred up like that.

choices.text: I'll be on my way, then.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: No need to be so polite. You should visit again when you have the time.

choices.text: I'll be on my way, then.
I'll be on my way, then.

dialogues.speaker: Tournament Notice
dialogues.text: Timmie is breezing right through the tournament as if he has the blessing of the Anemo Archon! And now he's one of the favorites to win Mondstadt's regional final!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: Little Timmie really is something else. You all should've seen him play against that golden-haired lass, the way he won...

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Reply
dialogues.text: How absurd! Did you not see the plume glowing with holy light on that young boy's back?

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Reply
dialogues.text: Its scorching light must have shackled and blinded the Prinzessin's Auge der Verurteilung and twisted the scales of fate!

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Reply
dialogues.text: I shall bring my faithful retainers from the Immernachtreich, and vengeance shall be mine!

dialogues.speaker: Scribbled-Over, Almost Illegible Message
dialogues.text: ██y, don't ██ too late. If you see this ██, don't ██ to come back ██ for ██.

dialogues.speaker: Tournament Notice
dialogues.text: Be sure to visit the food stalls next to the tournament grounds, with a variety of snacks sure to please the palate! The Limited Edition Minty Qingxin Cakes are selling out quick!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: Do these Minty Qingxin Cakes live up to the hype? I keep coming back but I've never managed to get my hands on one...

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: New to the tournament venue, huh? Word is that the snack is a favorite among the adepti, so it sold out on the first day.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: It does taste refreshing, but it's also just a little bit bitter.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: It's so bitter.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: It's so bitter my tongue shriveled.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: It tastes good.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Ugh, now I'm curious! When's this snack gonna be back on sale? Come on, you're missing out on so much business!

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Speaking of the adepti... Do they also play Genius Invokation TCG?

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Everyone likes to have fun, right?

dialogues.speaker: Tournament Notice
dialogues.text: In Inazuma's regional final, Guuji Yae Miko of the Grand Narukami Shrine will be facing off against Sangonomiya Kokomi, Divine Priestess of the Sangonomiya Shrine!

dialogues.speaker: Tournament Notice
dialogues.text: Will the imperious crash of thunder make itself heard within the unfathomable deeps?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Publishing House Advertisement
dialogues.text: The revised hardcover version of King of Invokations is now available for purchase at all tournament venues! Free gift of Forbidden Dice with each purchase!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: I'll always support Yae Miko-sama!

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: She doesn't have a chance. I'm confident Madam Sangonomiya Kokomi will be the one that emerges victorious.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: In your dreams! Why don't you put your money where your mouth is and bet on it?

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Bring it on! Loser pays for dinner!

dialogues.speaker: The Tenryou Commission's Reply
dialogues.text: Please abide by the tournament venue's rules and enjoy the tournament in a respectful manner.

dialogues.speaker: Tournament Notice
dialogues.text: The exciting King of Invokations Grand Prix is in full swing! Many outstanding players have emerged from the competiton. Come participate in the duels today!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: Huh, I didn't think you building designers could play cards so well. Quite a few players from Kshahrewar made it to the quarterfinals.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: What do you mean, "building designers"? We study structural geometry and mechanism theory, and it's MUCH more complex than staring at words all day in Haravatat.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Staring at words all day"? You should try "staring at words" a bit, maybe then you'd learn to write! Linguistics and Rune Studies are both extremely profound fields of knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Everyone has their specialties. But since nobody is willing to yield, why don't we organize an Interdarshan Invokation Championship?

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Good idea!

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Great idea!

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: I'll see you at the tournament!

dialogues.speaker: Onnea
dialogues.text: I can't mess up the Guild's assignment...

dialogues.speaker: Onnea
dialogues.text: Wh—Whoa! How many Scenic Checkpoints have you found? Anyway, I wish you the best of luck!

dialogues.speaker: Frida
dialogues.text: Traveler, are you here to try Zero Hour Invokation?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Frida
dialogues.text: No problem! Please select the cards you'd like to use.

dialogues.speaker: Frida
dialogues.text: Oh, and your opponent will be... Let's see... Many players enter the contest using nicknames, and some of them are pretty hard to remember...

dialogues.speaker: Frida
dialogues.text: Here it is! Your opponent will be Cheerful Torchbearer. Once you're prepared, you may begin anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Frida
dialogues.text: That's alright. Zero Hour Invokation isn't just a one-day event.

dialogues.speaker: Frida
dialogues.text: You're welcome to come take part anytime during the Grand Prix event period.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: So you're the one I'll be playing against! It's a real competition this time, so you'd better be ready!

choices.text: I've got other things to do right now...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Okay! I need to go over my deck one more time, and if things don't work out... I guess I'll have to ask someone for advice.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I won this round.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Whoa... You're so much better than everyone I've played against...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I'll give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Luozi
dialogues.text: The King of Invokations Grand Prix sure has attracted a lot of people...

dialogues.speaker: Luozi
dialogues.text: Hey there, Traveler. Are you here to take part in the Grand Prix as well?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Zero Hour Invokation...

dialogues.speaker: Luozi
dialogues.text: Oh, you're interested in trying this out? Sure, you can build your deck over here.

dialogues.speaker: Luozi
dialogues.text: You'll be playing against Hong'yu. Good luck!

dialogues.speaker: Luozi
dialogues.text: I never expected Zero Hour Invokation to be so popular... Hmm, I think I'm sensing some business opportunities...

dialogues.speaker: Luozi
dialogues.text: Ahem! Please build your deck here and let me know if you need any help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the mechanical paintings...

dialogues.speaker: Luozi
dialogues.text: Mechanical paintings? Oh, you mean those paintings you can freely take apart and reassemble?

dialogues.speaker: Luozi
dialogues.text: They're right over here. The Guild brought them over not long ago.

dialogues.speaker: Luozi
dialogues.text: If you're interested, you can give them a try right away.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Seems like you'll be playing against me this time... Great! I was just looking for a worthy opponent.

choices.text: I've got other things to do right now...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: A decisive victory is rather difficult to achieve in this tournament.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: *sigh* Turns out I couldn't just place all of my trust in the guide...

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: You truly were a worthy opponent.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Zero Hour Invokation...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Luozi
dialogues.text: Alright. I'll be at this booth throughout the Grand Prix event period.

dialogues.speaker: Luozi
dialogues.text: If you have any questions, just come ask me directly.

dialogues.speaker: Takugen
dialogues.text: The theme isn't bad, but as for the plot... I wonder if it's good enough...

dialogues.speaker: Takugen
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler! My apologies. I got distracted for a moment thinking about light novels...

dialogues.speaker: Takugen
dialogues.text: Is there anything I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Zero Hour Invokation...

dialogues.speaker: Takugen
dialogues.text: Oh, that's right, I'm the one in charge of Zero Hour Invokation. Are you here to play?

dialogues.speaker: Takugen
dialogues.text: You're welcome to build your deck here. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask me.

dialogues.speaker: Takugen
dialogues.text: Your opponent Secchu Tou is ready to begin. You may start the match anytime once you're prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the mechanical paintings...

dialogues.speaker: Takugen
dialogues.text: Mr. Félix's mechanical paintings are right over here! Oh, what intricate works of art... Even I have tried them many times myself.

dialogues.speaker: Takugen
dialogues.text: It's such a pleasure to enjoy works like these...

dialogues.speaker: Takugen
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm sorry... Let's get back to the topic.

dialogues.speaker: Takugen
dialogues.text: If you're interested in trying the mechanical paintings, you should head over and take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: We're in a real competition, so please don't feel obliged to go easy on me.

choices.text: I've got other things to do right now...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: I'll be looking into building a more optimal deck. It's a formal competition after all, and I shouldn't make a fool of myself.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Phew... I really was beaten by the best.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Were you distracted during our match? Hehe, I could tell.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Zero Hour Invokation...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Takugen
dialogues.text: That's alright, I won't be going anywhere for a while. I have a job to do after all...

dialogues.speaker: Takugen
dialogues.text: If you're interested in trying Zero Hour Invokation, you're welcome to find me anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Dunia
dialogues.text: Genius Invokation TCG and mechanical paintings... Do these two have anything in common at all?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Zero Hour Invokation...

dialogues.speaker: Dunia
dialogues.text: Oh? You're interested in Zero Hour Invokation?

dialogues.speaker: Dunia
dialogues.text: No problem, please build your deck here. If you have any other questions, just ask me anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Dunia
dialogues.text: We have a player called "Revived Serval" currently waiting for an opponent.

dialogues.speaker: Dunia
dialogues.text: You may begin once you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the mechanical paintings...

dialogues.speaker: Dunia
dialogues.text: The mechanisms crafted by that Fontaine man? I placed them over there.

dialogues.speaker: Dunia
dialogues.text: Me? I'm not interested in mechanisms and the like, so I haven't taken a closer look at them.

dialogues.speaker: Dunia
dialogues.text: If you're interested, though, feel free to check them out.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Whoa... There are so many players crowded around... Uhh, I'm getting kinda nervous...

choices.text: I've got other things to do right now...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: You're leaving? Uh, me? I'm gonna meet up with Master. Where were we supposed to meet again...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I—I've never been in a situation like that before...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I finally won! Looks like my trip here wasn't in vain after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Zero Hour Invokation...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Zero Hour Invokation...

dialogues.speaker: Dunia
dialogues.text: Oh? You're interested in Zero Hour Invokation?

dialogues.speaker: Dunia
dialogues.text: No problem, please build your deck here. If you have any other questions, just ask me anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Zero Hour Invokation...

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: You look like you're raring to go... Let's get started then.

choices.text: I've got other things to do right now...

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: There are so many people participating in this tournament, my ears are starting to hurt... ugh.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Color me impressed. It looks like you came well-prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Don't be discouraged. I may have won this time, but you can always try to win the next round.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Dunia
dialogues.text: Sure, you go ahead. I'll be here throughout the King of Invokations Grand Prix.

dialogues.speaker: Dunia
dialogues.text: If you ever feel like playing Zero Hour Invokation, just come find me here. I'll get everything prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler, it's you. Would you like to try this painting out?

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Haha, great! I'm sure you'll solve this mechanical painting in no time.

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: The mechanical painting's over here. You may begin whenever you're ready.

choices.text: I've got something else to do.

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Uh... okay then. Feel free to stop by when you get the chance! I won't be going anywhere for the time being...

dialogues.speaker: Fein
dialogues.text: Traveler, would you like to try Heart of the Dice?

response.speaker: Fein
response.text: No problem. Um, have you finished reading the rulebook yet?

response.speaker: Fein
response.text: Oh, it's fine, you don't have to read it cover to cover to play. You can always learn as you play.

choices.text: I've got something else to do.

response.speaker: Fein
response.text: You're busy? Alright then, feel free to come find me anytime. This booth will be here throughout the King of Invokations Grand Prix event period.
